title: Wheaties 2 on 1
description: A continuous two-part 2-on-1 progression that begins with a full-ice rush and then immediately creates a second 2-on-1 below the dots after a corner dump.
coaching_points: Forwards fill separate lanes and keep sticks available as passing targets.
Defenders surf the rush, hold a useful gap, and keep sticks in passing lanes.
After the first rush, transition quickly into the down-low 2-on-1.
Communicate on both the rush and low-zone attack.

title: 32 Get Back
description: A tracking and regroup progression where forwards recover to strip a puck, connect with defensemen, regroup, and attack. A second whistle creates another retrieval and regroup before the next rush.
coaching_points: Track back with urgency and lift or disrupt the puck carrier's stick.
Move the recovered puck to the defense quickly.
Forwards regroup with timing and present clear passing options.
Attack through middle ice before finishing the rush.

title: Shot Into Gap Up 1 v 1
description: A tight-area 1-on-1 that begins with a shot, then forces the shooter to recover and gap an attacker entering around a cone. The offensive player works to drive the net under pressure.
coaching_points: Defender matches speed and protects the middle.
Use stick-on-puck pressure and angle toward the boards.
Attacker keeps feet moving and looks for an inside cut if available.
If the middle is closed, protect the puck and continue the net drive.

title: Nobles 2 V 2 + 2 Teammates Transition Game
description: A continuous 2-on-2 battle that becomes a 4-on-2 when the team gaining possession connects with two support teammates along the boards.
coaching_points: Transition possession to the support players immediately after a turnover.
Use switches, exchanges, and quick puck movement to exploit the 4-on-2.
Attackers get inside and create quick-release shooting chances.
Defenders keep the puck outside and protect passing lanes.

title: Red Baron Game
description: A cross-ice 3-on-3 game with one permanent all-time offensive player, creating a continuous 4-on-3 advantage for whichever team has possession.
coaching_points: Use the extra attacker by spreading the ice and supporting the puck carrier.
Move the puck before pressure closes.
Defenders keep sticks in passing lanes and protect inside ice.
Transition immediately when possession changes because the extra player changes teams with the puck.

title: Larionov 5 V 3 Alternating Warm-Up Drill
description: A 5-on-3 keep-away warm-up designed to sharpen puck protection, awareness, passing, deception, and decision making before practice.
coaching_points: Puck carriers use changes of speed, cutbacks, and deception to create lanes.
Players without the puck move constantly and keep sticks available.
Use switches and scissors to create confusion for defenders.
Defenders use active sticks and force possession toward the outside.

title: Net Drive & Angle Drill
description: A full-ice 1-on-1 where the attacker builds speed through a cone route and drives back toward the offensive zone while the defender recovers, fronts the rush, and works to angle outside.
coaching_points: Defender stays patient and takes back ice before closing.
Use the stick to steer the attacker away from middle ice.
Attacker protects the puck through contact and changes speed to create separation.
Drive the net when available instead of drifting toward the corner.

title: Continuous 1 on 1 Puck Retrieval Drill
description: A continuous corner-retrieval drill where the puck carrier absorbs and initiates controlled contact to separate from a trailing defender before turning off the wall and attacking the net.
coaching_points: Retrieve with awareness of pressure and protect the puck before contact arrives.
Use body position to create separation from the defender.
Turn off the wall with control and attack the net.
Rotate continuously so the next retrieval begins immediately.

title: 1 v 1 v 1 Game
description: A three-player possession game in a confined area where one puck carrier must read and evade two opponents. A gate-scoring variation rewards players for protecting the puck while attacking middle ice.
coaching_points: Keep the head up and process both defenders instead of focusing on one.
Stay off the wall when possible to preserve more escape options.
Use deceptive turns and changes of speed to protect possession.
Shrink the playing area as players improve.

title: Yellow Attack Timing - V1
description: A retrieval-and-timing drill where one player chips a puck into the corner, the retriever shoulder-checks and makes a pass, and the original passer times a route around or in front of the net for a quick shot.
coaching_points: Retriever shoulder-checks before collecting the puck and exits with the head up.
The shooter times the route rather than arriving too early.
Both players use deception to create passing and shooting space.
Finish with a quick release after the pass.
